requirements.lead_text: After obtaining permission from the appropriate authority, look at and study a place of worship, school grounds, or a public building and identify where most people arrive by bus or car. Then do the following:
requirements.req_text: After obtaining permission from the appropriate authority, look at and study a place of worship, school grounds, or a public building and identify where most people arrive by bus or car. Then do the following: (a) Using a measuring tape, measure and draw the main site entry and its nearby area. Define the scale of your drawing. Be sure to include the driveway and sidewalk or path that leads to the building's main entry. Indicate any sidewalks, structures, trees and plants, lights, drains, utilities, or other site furnishings within the study area. Make two copies of this plan and save the original, then do 4(b) and 4(c) using the copies. (b) On one copy of your site plan, use directional arrows to indicate where the water drains across the site, where ditches occur, and where water stands for a longer period of time. (c) Decide how you can make the place safer and more comfortable for those using it. Redesign the area on another copy of the plan. You may want to include new walks, covered waiting areas, benches, space-defining plantings of trees and shrubs, and drainage structures.

sub_requirements.label: (a)

Make two copies of this plan and save the original, then do 4(b) and 4(c) using the copies.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 5): Identify three career opportunities that would use skills and knowledge in landscape architecture.
Core Standard 2 (Req 5): Pick one and research the training, education, certification requirements, experience, and expenses associated with entering the field.
Core Standard 3 (Req 5): Research the prospects for employment, starting salary, advancement opportunities, and career goals associated with this career.
Core Standard 4 (Req 5): Discuss what you learned with your counselor and whether you might be interested in this career.
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 - Review Standard (Req 5): Read the official Landscape Architecture requirement and identify the key questions, terms, or skills covered in Careers & Professional Pathways.
Step 2 - Gather Evidence & Examples: Research the required facts in the Landscape Architecture Pamphlet and record structured notes in your Scout Workbook.
Step 3 - Practice & Apply (Identify): Work with your patrol buddy or family (as required) to identify each element of Careers & Professional Pathways with concrete real-world examples.
Step 4 - Counselor Conference & Sign-Off: Present your completed workbook organizer and identify your understanding to your Merit Badge Counselor for Blue Card verification.
